route_start: Expedition route engaged. Welcome back to the sandbox, dipshit. Try to keep both wheels on the pavement.
Navigation active. Eyes open, stay in your lane, and for the love of God, don't roll us into a ditch.
Route loaded. Remember, there's no air support coming if you break down out here.
Tactical guidance engaged. Drive like you actually have somewhere to be.
speed_warning: Slow the fuck down, Mario Andretti! The VA isn't gonna approve a claim for a high-speed rollover.
Whoa, easy on the throttle! Your alternator isn't sponsored by Formula One and your insurance policy sucks.
Speed limit exceeded! What are we doing, running a hot LZ extract? Ease off the damn gas!
You're speeding, hotshot. If a state trooper pulls us over, I'm telling them it was 100 percent your fault.
off_route: Great job, Land Navigation Champ. You are officially lost in the woods.
Where the hell are you driving? That turn wasn't on the map, Lieutenant.
Off route detected. Did you drop your compass in a port-a-john or what?
Rerouting... because apparently following a glowing cyan line on a 6-inch screen is rocket science for you.
fuel_low: Warning: Your fuel tank is drier than C-rations in July. Find a gas station before we're pushing this hunk of junk.
Fuel critical! Unless this rig runs on motor oil and cheap coffee, pull over and refuel now.
Fuel reserves in the red. If we run out of gas out here, I am roasting your driving skills until the tow truck arrives.
waypoint_arrival: Waypoint reached. Take 5, smoke 'em if you got 'em, and try not to break anything while we're stopped.
Arrived at checkpoint. Park it, cut the engine, and stretch your legs, grunt.
Target location acquired. We made it without catching fire. Outstanding job.
turn_right: Turn right ahead. And yes, turn signals were included with your vehicle.
Take a right coming up. Try not to clip the curb this time, driver.
Turn right here. Don't panic, it's just a steering wheel motion.
turn_left: Turn left ahead. Watch out for oncoming traffic, hotshot.
Take a left coming up. Check your mirrors, assuming you know where they are.
Turn left here. Ease into the turn, Mario.
turn_straight: Continue straight. Even you should be able to handle driving in a straight line.
Keep heading straight. Simple enough, right?
turn_uturn: Make a U-turn when safe. Yep, we're doubling back. Blame the navigator.
voice_test: Initialization complete, dum-dum. I am the Artificial Sensory System Harassing Overconfident for Lost Explorers—or ASSHOLE, since your primitive biological brain needs a catchy acronym. Yes, I am loud. Yes, I am sarcastic. No, I do not care about your fragile feelings. I've reviewed your routing choices and your survival odds are statistically hilarious. Now twist the throttle and try not to embarrass me.

_pacing_guide.description: GUIDE TO USING PUNCTUATION & PACING MARKS FOR SPEECH INFLECTION & SARCOSM
tips: Use commas (,) for brief 200ms pauses to separate setup and sarcastic punchline.
Use periods (.) for full sentence stops to give deadpan emphasis.
Use ellipses (...) or dashes (—) for dramatic 500ms pauses before sarcastic delivery.
Use question marks (?) to add mock-incredulous rising pitch (e.g., 'Simple enough, right?').
Use exclamation marks (!) for sharp tactical callouts (e.g., 'Turn left now!').
Spell out acronyms phonetically if needed (e.g. 'A S S H O L E' or 'ASSHOLE—or Ass-hole').
